title: LivingDrugOmics pipeline parameters
description: This Pipeline was developed supporting 10x Genomics single cell protocols, including gene expression, V(D)J repertoire and surface protein detection

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

samplesheet.description: The samples to run the analysis and QC processes on

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved. You have to use absolute paths to storage on Cloud infrastructure.

gene_expression_reference.description: The gene expression reference used by the CELLRANGER_MULTI process

gene_expression_source_fa.description: The FASTA file to build a gene expression reference with at runtime

gene_expression_source_gtf.description: The GTF file to build a gene expression reference with at runtime

gene_expression_car_fa.description: The FASTA file of the CAR seqence

gene_expression_car_gtf.description: The GTF file of the CAR annotation

gene_expression_reference_version.description: Version of the script to be used when building gene expression reference

gene_expression_source_fa_url.description: URL to download FASTA file from if gene_expression_source_fa is not provided

gene_expression_source_gtf_url.description: URL to download GTF file from if gene_expression_source_gtf is not provided

feature_reference.description: The feature reference used by the CELLRANGER_MULTI process

vdj_reference.description: The VDJ reference used by the CELLRANGER_MULTI process

scGate_model.description: Gating model used for cell type annotations

multiple_car_fa.description: The FASTA file containing several CAR isoforms to compare counts

cellranger_disable_ui.description: Flag to disable the Web-UI provided by the CellRanger processes

cellranger_enable_cluster.description: Experimental: Enable cluster mode for the CELLRANGER_MULTI process

cellranger_cluster_template.description: Experimental: Path of cluster template needed for cluster mode

cellranger_max_jobs.description: Experimental: Maximum number of jobs per CELLRANGER_MULTI process that can run in parallel

cellranger_mem_per_core.description: Experimental: Maximum ammount of Memory (in GB) that can be used by each CPU core

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline, typically set in a config file.
generic_options.help_text:
These options are common to all nf-core pipelines and allow you to customise some of the core preferences for how the pipeline runs.

Typically these options would be set in a Nextflow config file loaded for all pipeline runs, such as `~/.nextflow/config`.

pipeline_mode.description: Enum value to declare the set of workflows to run

validate_params.description: Boolean whether to validate parameters against the schema at runtime

trace_report_suffix.description: Suffix to add to the trace report filename. Default is the date and time in the format yyyy-MM-dd_HH-mm-ss.
